script.name: Reset Review Flags
script.description: Clears the Reviewed flag for a saved search.

input.sql: SELECT ArtifactID AS ID, TextIdentifier AS Name FROM EDDSDBO.Search

script.action: UPDATE EDDSDBO.Document SET Reviewed = 0 WHERE ArtifactID IN (SELECT ArtifactID FROM EDDSDBO.SavedSearchResults WHERE SearchID = #SearchID#)
